name: change_detection
description: Bi-temporal change detection via thresholded absolute pixel differencing. Compares two images of the same area taken at different times and produces a change map, a natural-language summary, and a compressed 8x4 grid signature of where the change occurred (classical CV, not a trained model).

modality.description: Modality of the input pair (used only for labeling the summary)

change_map_path.description: Path to the pixel-level change map

change_summary.description: Natural language summary of detected changes

changed_area_pct.description: Percentage of the scene that changed

change_embedding.description: 8x4 grid of mean pixel-difference magnitude, a compressed signature of where the change happened
